tagline: The efficient one. BBQnBBWs missed his projection by 33%.
file: A quiet, efficient contender. Cleanest lineup management on the board, until Week 6.
The workmanlike win. Josh Allen as the engine and a steady lineup behind him.
Painty69, who beat him by 16.06 in Week 6, and fumbduckdumbfuck, who beat him by 12.1 in Week 4.
Snipe58 in Week 7, and a FAAB budget that is untouched at $500.

2026.headline: 3-3, fourth place, and a bad Week 6
story: C33DeezNutzz opened with a 195.82, the highest score of Week 1, with Josh Allen providing 35.66, then lost to Hades9mm in Week 2, beat CMac91 in Week 3, lost to fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 4 and beat Zygon in Week 5, ending the unbeaten run.

Week 6 was a 111.52 to 95.46 loss to Painty69. Josh Allen led at only 18.3, Sleeper's report says he missed his 143.24 projection by 33%, and 24.5 stayed on the bench. He added Dameon Pierce for free.
He is 3-3, still fourth in the standings and fourth in points at 832.1, and holds the 1.06. FAAB is a full $500, and the desk keeps asking when it becomes a weapon. Snipe58 is next.
takes: The cleanest lineup in the league had its worst week of the month.
Quiet is not the same as safe, but it is close.
